title: Partition
markdown:
Rearranges subarray $a[lo \dots hi]$ around a pivot.

- **Outcome**: places pivot into its **final sorted index** $p$.
- **Return value**: returns index $p$, not the pivot value.
- **Subarray invariant**:
  - Left side ($a[lo \dots p-1]$): all values $\le$ pivot.
  - Right side ($a[p+1 \dots hi]$): all values $\ge$ pivot.
- Partition performs a single reorganization pass; it does not sort the subarrays.
